WorkspaceComponentLock.description: Resolved component selections pinned for one workspace.

WorkspaceId.description: Stable identifier of the workspace associated with this workspace component lock.

Entries.description: Lists the entries associated with this workspace component lock.

ComponentId.description: Stable identifier of the AAC component associated with this entry.

ComponentVersion.description: Version of the AAC component associated with this entry.

Sha256.description: Specifies the sha256 for this entry.

SourceId.description: Stable identifier of the source associated with this entry.

ArtifactUri.description: URI or URL identifying the artifact associated with this entry.

ArtifactFilename.description: Specifies the artifact filename for this entry.

PackageFormat.description: Specifies the package format for this entry.

DescriptorPath.description: Filesystem or logical descriptor path used by this entry.

RuntimePackage.description: Specifies the runtime package for this entry.

VerifierId.description: Stable identifier of the verifier associated with this entry.

Sidecars.description: Lists the sidecars associated with this entry.

Uri.description: URI or URL identifying the uri associated with this sidecar.

Suffix.description: Specifies the suffix for this sidecar.
